UGA.note: The joint programme aims at statistical system capacity in general; administrative records are named only as a gap and an aim, with no pilot, agreement or funded work stated for them.

facts.fact: The UN in Uganda release of 30 January 2024 says the US$ 41.9m Joint Programme for Data and Statistics is anchored on the Third Plan for National Statistical Development (PNSD III) 2020/21-2024/25.
